patthana23.45:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.45:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.45:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nadassanattike sanidassanattika dassanattikaṃ
